attr.title: Lighthouse
attr.desc: Banjo-Kazooie brought to you by HarbourMasters, complete with randomizer, anchor multiplayer, and enhancements! The Bear and Bird live on!
attr.inst: You need to provide your own roms. See the [Lighthouse](https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Lighthouse) repository for a list of supported rom hashes. At first boot you will be prompted to select your Banjo-Kazooie rom file via file picker. Once chosen, Torch will generate a `bk.o2r`.
